title: All 15 Webots integration scenarios passed
summary: This CI run tested the PR 'ci: harden dev Webots runner isolation' which modifies the CI workflow to use a RUN_KEY (run_id-run_attempt) for per-run resource naming, adds GPU capacity waiting, sets VOICEPRINT_DEVICE=cpu, and adds a runner-local cleanup step. All 15 scenarios (builtin, cap, flow) passed, including fault recovery, file roundtrip, plan control, camera/lidar snapshots, explore smoke, mapping save, memory roundtrip, scene object listing, speech, voiceprint, and multi-step flows. The scene map persistence verification also passed 16/16 checks.
pr_changes: Modified .github/workflows/testing.yml: added concurrency group for GPU testing, added RUN_ATTEMPT and RUN_KEY env vars, added ROBONIX_CI_MIN_GPU_FREE_MIB variable, set VOICEPRINT_DEVICE=cpu, removed ROBONIX_HOME env, added 'Wait for runner GPU capacity' step, changed runtime_dir and container names to use RUN_KEY, added 'Clean runner-local run directory' step, updated various docker commands to use RUN_KEY.
Modified testing/simulate_ci.py: improved synthetic_text_for_regex to handle regex patterns with \s, \d, .* and escaped characters; added handling for 'regex' assertion op in _satisfy_check.
Modified testing/verify_scene_map_persistence.py: added --dimension-tolerance-cells argument (default 2) and used it to allow small drift in occupancy grid dimensions during save/load verification.
test_result: All 15 scenarios passed (15/15, 100%). Coverage includes 20 capabilities across builtin, cap, and flow families. Scene map persistence verification passed 16/16 checks. The explore skill timed out as expected (5.0s and 8.0s ceilings). Navigation goals succeeded. Memory save/search roundtripped correctly. Camera and lidar snapshots returned valid data.
suggested_fix: No fix needed. Monitor the new GPU capacity waiting step and runner-local cleanup for any future timeout or permission issues.
risks_or_watchouts: The new GPU capacity waiting step may increase CI duration if GPU is busy.
The VOICEPRINT_DEVICE=cpu change may affect voiceprint performance in CI.
The dimension tolerance in map persistence verification may mask subtle map changes.
